title: 第9章 难忘一餐，难忘的面
novel_title: 都重生了谁还复读？去当兵吧(酸辣榔头)
content_zh: 新兵连的第一餐，让人过目难忘。更让人......难以下咽。冷冰冰的不锈钢餐盘里，一个皱巴巴的煮土豆，一小堆形似焦黄的面粉，还有一碗清水，这便是每个新兵入伍第一餐的全部。新兵们面露难色，但在班长的命令下，却又不得不拿起筷子。陆阳拿起土豆时，发现冰冰凉凉，似乎在冰柜里冻过？咬下去硬邦邦，还有点儿拔牙齿，口感像极了一根半融化的土豆味冰棍。至于那堆形似面粉的东西，陆阳原以为会像老家一种老少咸宜的茶食“京果粉”那般，入口应该是甜腻腻的才对。可当他用筷子挑起少许送进嘴里后才发现，竟然是咸的？且粉末一进到嘴里，就瞬间把唾液吸干，黏在上牙膛上。即便是用水送服，下咽的过程也不好受，甚至有些拉嗓子。噗！忽然，丁腾飞像个干粉灭火器似的，喷了一桌子。他先前吃的太大口，一不小心让粉末呛进气管，这才全都喷了出来。班长周凯东皱着眉头扫了眼，却并未说话，反倒是孔垄和其他几个新兵露出幸灾乐祸的表情。“草，这特么是人吃的吗？”似是因为丢了面子，丁腾飞擦着嘴，低声槽骂了一句。但下一秒，周凯东就放下筷子，用凌厉的眼神冷冷盯着他。“丁腾飞，你刚说什么？”“啊，没有啊？”丁腾飞装作无辜，想要借机蒙混过关。陆阳看在眼里，只觉得十分可笑。在课堂上面对老师，这招或许是管用的，但这里是部队。果不其然，周凯东直接拽着他的脖领子，将他粗暴地从位置上拖拽起来。力气大的，连身后板凳都被撞倒，弄出的动静也吸引了食堂里所有人的好奇。周凯东几乎是脸贴脸的站在丁腾飞面前，声色俱厉的说道：“给我把你，刚才说的话，重复一遍！”丁腾飞还在极力狡辩，但周凯东根本就不吃这一套。这时，连长高峰走上来，询问什么情况。周凯东并没有在连长面前揭新兵老底，只是说了句。“这小子闹情绪。”“闹个情绪，弄这么大动静？”高峰象征性的批评了周凯一句，随后便冲丁腾飞说：“坐下，吃饭。”见有人替自已做主，丁腾飞忽然就觉得自已又行了，借机发起老牢骚。“连长，我们坐了二十几个小时火车，走了这么远路来部队，就给我们吃这些玩意儿，能吃饱吗？”此话一出，高峰的脸色瞬间冰冷下来，但他并没有冲着丁腾飞发难。而是走过去拿起丁腾飞餐盘里的冻土豆咬了一口，又咬了一口。直到把这枚土豆吃进肚子里，他这才冲着所有新兵，用非常严肃的语气说道。“我们特三团的前身，是龙国人民志愿军第十七师302团！”“在抗米援朝的多个战役里，我们团多次击退敌军，一次又一次坚守住阵地！”“大家现在吃到的冻土豆和炒面粉，就是战士们当时最好的粮食补给，就这还不是每个战士都能吃得到！”“先前，之所以让你们跑那么远的路，就是为了让你们更好的去了解我们特三团的军史，更加深刻的体会当初先烈们艰辛！”这一刻，新兵们才意识到这并不是老兵的整蛊，也不是给新兵的下马威。而是在用切身体会的方式，生动的重演一遍，当初先烈们来时的路。三所里急行军的故事，陆阳也曾听说过，那是人类轻步兵史上的巅峰。零下三十度的冰天雪地，战士们要背着七十斤的装备，在山上连夜奔袭七十二点五公里阻击敌人。而餐盘里这些，是当时的志愿军战士们唯一能够补充体力的来源。都说一口雪水一把炒面，冻土豆也能当盛宴，但更多的时候，能吃的只有雪。新兵们不再抱怨，认认真真的将食物送进嘴里，连洒在桌边的也用手指捏起来，这是对先辈们的致敬，和最起码的尊重。连长高峰转过身，一个目光就让丁腾飞打了个哆嗦。但他却并没有去批评，而是报以理解的微笑拍拍他。“不愿意吃，说明还不够饿，饿了树皮都能当肉啃了！”“你就站这看着，不爱吃也不强求。三班长，他那一份不许浪费！”“是！”周凯东重新坐回位置上，将丁腾飞餐盘里的炒面，平均分配给其他人。炒面，并非大家所熟知的炒面条，而是由五谷杂粮磨成粉，混合面粉炒制而成的食品。非常扛饿，可以理解为没有压缩成型，营养成分表相对单一的压缩饼干。陆阳倒了点儿水在炒面上，筷子豁楞豁楞后，唏哩呼噜的就送进嘴里，还真别说这样口感要比先前好吃很多。“班长，还有吗？”“.......”周凯东没料到，这小子竟然还想添饭？于是把自已餐盘往前推了推，笑眯眯的说了句。“干脆我别吃了，让给你？”陆阳露出礼貌又不失尴尬的微笑，连忙摆手拒绝。他是真没吃饱，这些食物分量太小，根本填不饱肚子。虽然，他知道饥饿也是这节体验课的一部分，但经验告诉他想吃饱饭就别怕难为情，别怕张嘴。现代部队条件比以前好太多，只要你说饿，班长总能想法子挤出点儿奶水来让填饱肚子。孔垄见陆阳先前兑水，搅拌混凝土的办法很不错，于是反其道而行之。他将炒面全部倒入装水的碗里，豁楞豁楞后成了一碗形似蛋白粉的营养补剂，然后仰头一口闷。再三下五除二的把土豆塞进嘴里，同时下意识的计算这一餐的热量，碳水，蛋白质摄入。“班长，不够吃，能再来点儿吗？”孔垄成了继陆阳之后，第二个想要再添点儿的。周凯东眼角抽了抽，心说我怎么摊上你俩这吃货？他把头扭向一旁，干脆直接选择无视。孔垄这家伙和陆阳不同，肌肉大，脑子小。但凡自已把餐盘推出去，他百分百会伸手拿过去，然后说一声：谢谢嗷！见边上丁腾飞一副站没站相，依旧吊儿郎当的样子，周凯东脸上闪过戏谑的冷笑。而这个异样的表情，正巧被陆阳敏锐的捕捉到，难道说还有反转？......“报告连长，忆苦饭全部吃完！”值班员在检查完全体新兵餐盘后，来到连长面前汇报。高峰点点头，随后便吩咐：“好，可以正式开饭了！”丁腾飞：“？？？？？”新兵们：“？？？？？”很快，一道道提前在保温箱里保温的菜肴，便被送上餐桌。土豆烧鸡，番茄牛腩，青椒肉丝，酸辣海带，番茄鸡蛋汤，最后是一大盆香气扑鼻的白米饭。“忆苦思甜，忆苦思甜！”“先前，只是让你们牢记先辈们曾经的付出，并不是让大家一味地吃苦！”连长宣布正是开饭，强调“坐着的”敞开肚皮吃，不够让炊事班加菜都行。新兵们激动坏了，都说部队套路多，这话一点儿也不假。一道道美味可口的菜肴，和先前的“饭前点心”形成鲜明对比，吃的战士们满嘴流油，根本停不下来。陆阳从口袋里摸出最后三个咸鸭蛋，分给同桌的几个战友。并敲开一个后，顺手递给了坐在对面班长。见周凯东用一副怪异的眼神看着自已，陆阳笑着说：“老家特产，最后一个了，这不算贿赂吧？”孔垄插嘴：“班长，这鸭蛋齁咸齁咸的，你不吃给我？”周凯东瞪了他一眼：火车上空口吃特么三个，你跟老子说咸？他给了陆阳一个你小子懂事的眼神，咸蛋黄的油脂拌在米饭上，连带着米粒都变得金黄起来，看着就很有食欲。周凯东大口大口的扒饭，眉头不由自主的挑了起来，似乎在细细品味。“怎么样，好吃吗？”“拌稀饭吃，味道会更好。”陆阳笑了，没想到班长还挺识货的。他瞥了眼边上罚站丁腾飞，不由得心生感慨。部队真的挺人性化，不想吃，绝对不勉强。于是，陆阳将烧鸡的汤汁泡在米饭里，又夹了好些菜。“米饭，依旧是一小碗儿！”只见他搅拌均匀后大口大口扒饭，吃得那叫一个香，差点儿没给丁腾飞馋哭了......
content_en: The first meal of the recruit company was unforgettable.Even more...hard to swallow.On a cold stainless steel plate, there is a wrinkled boiled potato, a small pile of brown flour, and a bowl of water. This is the first meal for every recruit when he joins the army.The recruits looked embarrassed, but under the squad leader's order, they had to pick up their chopsticks.When Lu Yang picked up the potatoes, he found that they were ice cold, as if they had been frozen in the freezer?It's hard when you bite into it, and it's a bit tooth-pulling, and it tastes like a half-melted potato-flavored popsicle.As for the pile of flour-like things, Lu Yang originally thought it would be like "Jingguo Fen", a tea snack in his hometown that is suitable for all ages. It should be sweet and greasy in the mouth.But when he picked up a little with chopsticks and put it into his mouth, he realized that it was salty?And as soon as the powder enters the mouth, it immediately absorbs the saliva and sticks to the upper teeth.Even if it is taken with water, the swallowing process is uncomfortable and may even cause throat irritation.puff!Suddenly, Ding Tengfei sprayed all over the table like a dry powder fire extinguisher.He ate too much before and accidentally choked the powder into his trachea, and then all the powder came out.Squad leader Zhou Kaidong frowned and glanced, but did not speak. Instead, Kong Long and several other recruits showed gloating expressions."Fuck, is this really for human consumption?" As if he had lost face, Ding Tengfei wiped his mouth and cursed in a low voice.But the next second, Zhou Kaidong put down his chopsticks and stared at him coldly with sharp eyes."Ding Tengfei, what did you just say?" "Ah, no?" Ding Tengfei pretended to be innocent and wanted to take the opportunity to get through.Lu Yang saw it and felt it was very ridiculous.This might work in class with a teacher, but this is the military.Sure enough, Zhou Kaidong directly grabbed him by the collar and roughly dragged him up from his position.He was so strong that the bench behind him was knocked down, and the movement he made attracted the curiosity of everyone in the cafeteria.Zhou Kaidong stood in front of Ding Tengfei almost face to face, and said in a stern tone: "Repeat what you just said to me!" Ding Tengfei was still trying his best to quibble, but Zhou Kaidong didn't accept this at all.At this time, the company commander Gao Feng came up and asked what was going on.Zhou Kaidong didn't reveal the recruit's background in front of the company commander, he just said a few words."This kid is in a mood." "A mood in a mood to make such a big noise?" Gao Feng symbolically criticized Zhou Kai, and then said to Ding Tengfei: "Sit down and eat." Seeing someone making the decision for him, Ding Tengfei suddenly felt that he could do it again, and took the opportunity to complain."Company Commander, we have been on the train for more than 20 hours and have traveled such a long way to join the army. Can we be full just by giving us these things?" As soon as these words came out, Gao Feng's face instantly turned cold, but he did not attack Ding Tengfei.Instead, he walked over and picked up the frozen potatoes on Ding Tengfei's plate, took a bite, and then took another bite.It wasn't until he had eaten the potato that he spoke to all the recruits in a very serious tone."The predecessor of our Third Special Regiment was the 302nd Regiment of the 17th Division of the Longguo People's Volunteer Army!" "In the many battles to resist the Japanese aggression and aid Korea, our regiment repelled the enemy many times and held the position time and time again!" "The frozen potatoes and fried flour that everyone eats now were the best food supplies for the soldiers at that time, and that's not all.Every soldier can eat it!" "The reason why I asked you to travel such a long way is to let you better understand the military history of our special regiment and have a deeper understanding of the hardships of the martyrs!" At this moment, the recruits realized that this was not a prank by the veterans, nor was it a way to intimidate the recruits.Rather, it is a vivid reenactment of the path taken by the martyrs in a personal way.Lu Yang had also heard the story of the emergency march in the three camps. It was the pinnacle in the history of human light infantry.In the ice and snow at minus 30 degrees Celsius, the soldiers had to carry 70 kilograms of equipment on their backs and rush 72.5 kilometers up the mountain overnight to stop the enemy.These on the dinner plate were the only source of energy for the volunteer soldiers at that time.It is said that a mouthful of snow water, a handful of fried noodles, and frozen potatoes can also serve as a feast, but more often than not, the only thing that can be eaten is snow.The recruits stopped complaining and put the food into their mouths seriously. Even the food that was spilled on the table was picked up with their fingers. This was a tribute to their ancestors and the most basic respect.Company Commander Gao Feng turned around and his glance made Ding Tengfei tremble.But he did not criticize, but patted him with an understanding smile."If you don't want to eat, it means you are not hungry enough. If you are hungry, you can eat the bark as meat!" "Just stand here and watch. If you don't like to eat, don't force it. Third squad leader, don't waste his share!" "Yes!" Zhou Kaidong sat back down and distributed the fried noodles on Ding Tengfei's plate equally to the others.Chow mein is not the familiar fried noodles, but a food made from grinding whole grains into powder and mixing it with flour and frying it.Very hungry, it can be understood as a compressed biscuit that is not compressed and has a relatively simple nutritional label.Lu Yang poured some water on the fried noodles. After squeezing the noodles with his chopsticks, he put it into his mouth with a slurping sound. Not to mention it tasted much better than before."Squad leader, are there any more?" "..." Zhou Kaidong didn't expect that this kid would still want to add more food?So he pushed his plate forward and said with a smile."Why don't I just stop eating and give it to you?" Lu Yang showed a polite yet embarrassed smile and quickly waved his hand to refuse.He really wasn't full. The food was too small to fill his stomach.Although he knows that hunger is also part of this experience class, experience tells him that if he wants to eat enough, don't be afraid of being embarrassed and don't be afraid to open your mouth.The conditions of the modern army are much better than before. As long as you say you are hungry, the squad leader can always find a way to squeeze out some milk to fill your stomach.Kong Long saw that Lu Yang's previous method of mixing water and concrete was very good, so he did the opposite.He poured all the fried noodles into a bowl filled with water, and it turned into a bowl of nutritional supplements that looked like protein powder. He then raised his head and took a sip.He stuffed the potatoes into his mouth again and again, while subconsciously calculating the calories, carbohydrates, and protein intake of this meal."Squad leader, it's not enough. Can you have some more?" Kong Long became the second person after Lu Yang to want more.Zhou Kaidong's eyes twitched, and he thought to himself: How can I deal with foodies like you two?He turned his head to the side and simply chose to ignore it.Kong Long is different from Lu Yang. He has big muscles but a small brain.Whenever he pushes the plate out, he will definitely reach for it and say: Thank you!Seeing Ding Tengfei standing next to him, still looking carefree, a joking sneer flashed across Zhou Kaidong's face.And this strange expression happened to be captured keenly by Lu Yang. Could it be that there is a reversal?..."Report to the company commander, all the Yiku rice has been eaten!" After checking the dinner plates of all the recruits, the duty officer came to the company commander to report.Gao Feng nodded, and then said: "Okay, we can officially start the meal!" Ding Tengfei: "???????" The recruits: "???????" Soon, dishes that had been kept warm in the insulator in advance were delivered to the table.Potato roasted chicken, tomato beef brisket, green pepper shredded pork, hot and sour kelp, tomato egg soup, and finally a large bowl of fragrant white rice."Remember the bitter and think of the sweet, remember the bitter and think of the sweet!" "Previously, I just wanted you to remember the sacrifices of our ancestors, not to let you endure hardship blindly!" The company commander announced that it was time to eat, emphasizing that the "sitting" people ate with open stomachs, and the cooking team could add more food if it was not enough.The new recruits were very excited and said that the army had many tricks, which was not true at all.The delicious dishes were in sharp contrast to the previous "snacks". The soldiers' mouths were full of oil and they couldn't stop eating.Lu Yang took out the last three salted duck eggs from his pocket and distributed them to several comrades at the same table.After knocking one open, he handed it to the squad leader sitting opposite.Seeing Zhou Kaidong looking at him with a strange look, Lu Yang said with a smile: "This is the last special product from my hometown. Isn't this considered a bribe?" Kong Long interrupted: "Squad leader, these duck eggs are so salty, why don't you give them to me?" Zhou Kaidong glared at him: You ate three of them on the train, did you tell me they were salty?He gave Lu Yang a sensible look. The salted egg yolk oil was mixed on the rice, and even the rice grains turned golden, making him very appetizing.Zhou Kaidong took big mouthfuls of rice, his brows raised involuntarily, as if he was savoring it carefully."How is it? Is it delicious?" "Mix it with porridge. It will taste better." Lu Yang smiled. Unexpectedly, the monitor was quite knowledgeable.He glanced at Ding Tengfei standing next to him and couldn't help but sigh.The troops are really very humane. If you don’t want to eat, they will never force you to eat.So, Lu Yang soaked the chicken soup in the rice and added some vegetables."Rice, it's still a small bowl!" He stirred it evenly and then took big gulps of the rice. It was so delicious that Ding Tengfei almost cried with greed...
